The ACT's section 6.4 note says "The known source currently contains 19
binary mappings and 10 unary mappings".  The 19 was RE-DERIVED from the
actual entry tree: the live src/ast.c body of astBinOpFromToken has
exactly 19 `case` labels, and the oracle accepted exactly those 19 token
values.  The count is therefore MEASURED, not copied.
THE 10 UNARY MAPPINGS (CAND-020, NOT SELECTED) remain legacy C.  They
are inventoried but are NOT migrated by this ACT.
src/lexer.h defines several pairs of names for the SAME numeric value
(for example TK_SUPERSCRIPT and TK_STR are both 0x301).  The legacy
switch is written on the NUMERIC token value, so two spellings of the
same number are ONE case, not two.  This table therefore records one
row per DISTINCT NUMERIC token value.
None of the accepted token values (43, 45, 42, 47, 37, 61, 60, 62, 782,
aliased pair, and no distinction has been invented between aliased
numeric tokens: the mapping is defined on the numeric value alone.
